title: Forest Bathing | Explorer
speaker: National Geographic
zh: 【National Geographic】森林浴|探險家（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: If you think back in your life, can you think of a particular tree that was significant to you in some way?
cues.en: If you think back in your life, can you think of a particular tree that was significant to you in some way?
cues.zh: 如果您回顧自己的生活，您能想到一棵在某種程度上對您有重要意義的樹嗎？

cues.text: And I'd invite you to actually go and have a conversation with that tree.
cues.en: And I'd invite you to actually go and have a conversation with that tree.
cues.zh: 我邀請你真正去和那棵樹交談。

cues.text: So I'm going to go say hello to a tree.
cues.en: So I'm going to go say hello to a tree.
cues.zh: 所以我要去跟一棵樹打個招呼。

cues.text: Um, I'm David Marshall Gessner Jr.
cues.en: Um, I'm David Marshall Gessner Jr.
cues.zh: 嗯，我是小大衛馬歇爾蓋斯納。

cues.text: It turns out there's hard science behind this.
cues.en: It turns out there's hard science behind this.
cues.zh: 事實證明，這背後有硬科學。

cues.text: Forest bathing is based on something called Shintanyuku that was developed in Japan in the 1980s.
cues.en: Forest bathing is based on something called Shintanyuku that was developed in Japan in the 1980s.
cues.zh: 森林浴的基礎是 20 世紀 80 年代在日本開發的一種名為 Shintanyuku 的浴法。

cues.text: Researchers there have proven that walking in nature reduces stress hormones
cues.en: Researchers there have proven that walking in nature reduces stress hormones
cues.zh: 那裡的研究人員已經證明，在大自然中行走可以減少壓力荷爾蒙

cues.text: and lowers blood pressure and heart rate.
cues.en: and lowers blood pressure and heart rate.

cues.text: But they've also discovered something about trees that kind of blows my mind.
cues.en: But they've also discovered something about trees that kind of blows my mind.
cues.zh: 但他們也發現了一些關於樹木的事情，這讓我大吃一驚。

cues.text: Some trees like cypress give off chemical compounds called phytoncides.
cues.en: Some trees like cypress give off chemical compounds called phytoncides.
cues.zh: 有些樹木（例如柏樹）會釋放出稱為植物殺菌素的化合物。

cues.text: We absorb the phytoncides and they promote our natural killer cells which help us fight cancer.
cues.en: We absorb the phytoncides and they promote our natural killer cells which help us fight cancer.
cues.zh: 我們吸收植物殺菌劑，它們會促進自然殺手細胞的生長，幫助我們對抗癌症。

cues.text: We can experience a 40% increase in our natural killer cells from just walking in the woods.
cues.en: We can experience a 40% increase in our natural killer cells from just walking in the woods.
cues.zh: 只要在樹林裡散步，我們的自然殺手細胞就會增加 40%。

cues.text: I'd say that's a pretty good reason to start talking to trees.
cues.en: I'd say that's a pretty good reason to start talking to trees.
cues.zh: 我想說這是開始與樹木交談的一個很好的理由。
